description: This Java class defines the domain entity for recurring deposit schedule installments within a savings portfolio, including fields for installment details, methods for paying installments, and utilities for managing installment states.

classes.name: RecurringDepositScheduleInstallment
classes.description: Entity representing a scheduled installment for a recurring deposit, including installment details, payment tracking, and methods for managing installment payments and state.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new recurring deposit schedule installment with all details.

methods.name: installment
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new installment with minimal parameters (account, installment number, due date, deposit amount).

methods.name: payInstallment
methods.description: Method to process a payment towards the installment, updating the paid amount and obligations status.

methods.name: resetDerivedFields
methods.description: Resets calculation fields related to payments and obligations to initial state.

methods.name: updateDepositAmountAndResetDerivedFields
methods.description: Updates the deposit amount and resets related calculated fields.

methods.name: dueDate
methods.description: Getter for the due date of the installment.

methods.name: isObligationsMet
methods.description: Checks if all obligations for this installment are fulfilled.

methods.name: isNotFullyPaidOff
methods.description: Checks if the installment is not fully paid.

methods.name: isPrincipalCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the principal amount of the installment is fully paid.

methods.name: isPrincipalNotCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the principal amount of the installment is not fully paid.

methods.name: getDepositAmountOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the remaining deposit amount to be paid for this installment.

methods.name: getDepositAmountCompleted
methods.description: Returns the amount already paid for this installment.

methods.name: getDepositAmount
methods.description: Returns the total deposit amount for this installment.

methods.name: getTotalOutstanding
methods.description: Returns the total outstanding amount for the installment.
